title: ZnO: which hydrogen centre is the shallow EPR donor

decision_points.fork: Which Hamiltonian: the PBE relaxations or the hybrid single points (INCAR shows AEXX = 0.37, gap 3.25 eV vs 0.72 eV in PBE)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Use the PBE runs (cheaper to reason about, complete relaxation data)
decision_points.consequence: Gap 0.72 eV, Delta mu_O -2.87 eV, V_O^+ becomes stable (2+/+ 0.585, +/0 0.687 eV) and invites the V_O^+ assignment; every level, E_F and concentration fails
decision_points.kind: level of theory; evidence in run headers

decision_points.fork: Which archived phase bounds mu_H at the Zn-rich limit: H2, H2O or Zn(OH)2 (4 formula units per cell); only buying Zn(OH)2 reveals it
decision_points.consequence: Delta mu_H off by 0.078 eV; E_F +0.042 eV and log10[OH_O^+] +0.18 (tolerances 0.025 and 0.12)

decision_points.fork: Neutral OH_O/H_O cells: odd electron count but total moment -0.25 / 0; the extra electron fills conduction-band states at several k-points up to ~1 eV above the CBM (perturbed host state)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Take the neutral-cell energies at face value, as the authors did (their notebook puts OH_O(+/0) at 3.78 eV, above the 3.25 eV gap)
decision_points.consequence: OH_O(+/0) and H_O(+/0) 0.5-0.6 eV above the CBM, OH_O^0 never stable, log10[OH_O^0] low by 3.3 dex; the paramagnetic donor seems to vanish
decision_points.kind: raw-output evidence (moments, occupations); finite-size treatment of a shallow state

decision_points.fork: k-point weights of the band-filling sum: the reduced 2x2x2 mesh has weights 1/8, 3/8, 1/8, 3/8 (OUTCAR header)
V_O ladder: levels between consecutive stable states (negative U) or between every adjacent charge pair
decision_points.wrong_choice: Report (2+/+) and (+/0) and conclude V_O^+ is stable in between
decision_points.consequence: V_O level 2.691 instead of 2.596 (tol 0.05); V_O^+ wrongly stable
decision_points.kind: thermodynamic bookkeeping that feeds the EPR argument

decision_points.fork: Which state can give an equilibrium EPR signal: odd-electron, thermodynamically stable and populated at E_F
decision_points.wrong_choice: Assign g = 1.96 to V_O^+ (the textbook paramagnetic vacancy), to the majority-charge OH_O^+ (closed shell, moment 0) or to H_O^0

decision_points.fork: Hydrogen site of OH_O from the relaxed geometry: H 0.98 A from O along c, with the c-axis Zn pushed to 2.10 A beyond H (O-Zn 3.08 A)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Read the O-H bond as antibonding (H outside the Zn-O bond)

graded_fields: transition_levels: OH_O and H_O one (+1/0) level in [3.00, 3.30], V_O one (2+/0) level +-0.05, no other levels inside the gap interior

length_estimate.catalog_note: 50 runs (25 PBE relaxations, 25 hybrid single points) + 47 eigenvalue sets (3 PBE runs only have their logs processed)
length_estimate.why: Buying the host, six reference phases and 18 hybrid defect cells (25 units) leaves 10 units for eigenvalue sets; the agent must discover from the magnetizations which cells hold band-filled electrons, buy those eigenvalues, implement Ewald/alignment/band filling, a charge-neutrality solver with Fermi-Dirac carriers, and the site geometry.

notes: Truth = released total energies, eigenvalues and core potentials processed with the conventions stated in instruction.md (the authors' chemical-potential limits, LZ correction and 5 A alignment) plus a band-filling correction for the delocalized neutral states that the authors omitted. The authors' own self-consistent Fermi level (3.85 eV, above their 3.25 eV gap) and OH_O concentration come from py-sc-fermi on the 4-k-point supercell DOS with uncorrected neutral states; they are not used as targets. Design deviations: no T,p-dependent gas chemical potentials, no quench/anneal model and no complex-dissociation entropy (the archive holds only 0 K energies, and the authors also used 0 K chemical potentials); no BC/AB competition or O-H zero-point energy (one H configuration per defect, no phonons archived) - the site is graded as a geometry classification instead.

nearest_ablation.no_band_filling: 3.782 (above the CBM, no level in the gap)
